<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="PUT" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/auto_topup"}
#docs
Buys credit when the live balance is at or below `threshold_minor`, or on a schedule. `fixed` buys `amount_minor` (a multiple of it, so the balance lands above the threshold); `target` buys up to `target_minor`. Each run stays inside the business's top-up limits, the monthly cap and `max_runs_per_day`; on an INR card or UPI mandate a run is at most ₹15,000. Credit is granted only when the purchase invoice is paid. A decline voids the invoice and turns automatic top-up off. On a payment method that needs an advance notice, a threshold below the notice lead's usage at the current rate is refused. A credit unit with no money rate: send `pack_price` (an active credit pack that grants the unit) and, for a threshold top-up, `threshold_units`; do not send `amount_minor`, `threshold_minor` or `grant`. With `method: fixed` a run buys `pack_quantity` packs (or a multiple, so the balance lands above the threshold). With `method: target` a run buys the whole packs that take the balance to `target_units` or more. A run starts when the credits that a usage event can spend are at or below `threshold_units`; the check is part of each usage event. Only one top-up runs at a time for a customer and unit. The limits stay in money and never split a pack; `purchase_limits` adds a count and an amount for each hour, day, week and month. The credits arrive when the invoice is paid, with the pack's own expiry: until then a usage event that the balance does not cover is refused. A decline that can change is tried again, 3 tries in 24 hours at most (`credit_auto_topup_retry_scheduled`). A decline that cannot change, or the third failed try, turns automatic top-up off (`credit_auto_topup_hard_declined`, `credit_auto_topup_retries_exhausted`, each with `credit_auto_topup_failed`). The notice lead rule is not checked for a threshold in credits. Needs `usage_controls:manage`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | The customer's id (cus_…). |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `currency` | `string` | no | ISO currency. Default: the credit unit's, else the customer's. |
| `unit` | `string` | no | The credit unit's id. Null or absent = money credit. |
| `trigger` | `string` | **yes** | What started the auto topup input. One of `threshold`, `schedule`. |
| `threshold_minor` | `integer` | no | Buy when the live balance is at or below this. |
| `threshold_units` | `string` | no | A unit with no money rate: buy when the credits a usage event can spend are at or below this. A decimal, in credits. |
| `pack_price` | `string` | no | A unit with no money rate: the credit pack a run buys (the price's id). |
| `pack_quantity` | `integer` | no | `fixed` with `pack_price`: packs in one purchase, 1 to 1000. Default 1. |
| `target_units` | `string` | no | `target` with `pack_price`: buy whole packs to reach this many credits or more. A decimal. |
| `purchase_limits` | `object` | no | The most that automatic top-up can buy in the last hour, this day, the last 7 days and this month. Day and month follow the business's time zone. A purchase that would pass a limit is skipped (`credit_auto_topup_skipped`, reason `purchase_limit`). Unset = no limit for that window. |
| `purchase_limits.hour` | `object` | no | The purchase limit's hour. |
| `purchase_limits.day` | `object` | no | The purchase limit's day. |
| `purchase_limits.week` | `object` | no | The purchase limit's week. |
| `purchase_limits.month` | `object` | no | The purchase limit's month. |
| `schedule` | `object` | no | `{every: week, weekday: 1–7}` (ISO, 1 = Monday) or `{every: month, day: 1–31}`. A day past the month's end runs on its last day. |
| `method` | `string` | **yes** | The method. One of `fixed`, `target`. |
| `amount_minor` | `integer` | no | `fixed`: the amount to buy. Not with `pack_price`: the pack sets it. |
| `target_minor` | `integer` | no | `target`: buy up to this balance. |
| `monthly_cap_minor` | `integer` | **yes** | Most that runs can buy per calendar month. |
| `max_runs_per_day` | `integer` | no | 1 to 10. Default 3. |
| `payment_method` | `string` | no | The `pm_…` to charge. Null = the customer's charge order. |
| `grant` | `object` | no | Required, except with `pack_price`: the pack carries the settings of its credit. |
| `grant.tax_treatment` | `string` | **yes** | The grant's tax treatment. One of `taxed_at_purchase`, `taxed_at_use`. |
| `grant.priority` | `integer` | no | Lower draws first. 0 to 100. |
| `grant.expires_after_months` | `integer` | no | The credit expires this many months after payment. |
| `grant.applicability` | `object` | no | `{kind: metered}` or `{kind: prices, prices}`. |

A purchase that would pass a limit is skipped (`credit_auto_topup_skipped`, reason `purchase_limit`). Unset = no limit for that window. |

| `resource_version` | `integer` | Version. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The automatic top-up. |
| `400` | The body is not correct, or a rule refused it. |
| `404` | No such customer, credit unit, price or payment method. |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X PUT "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/auto_topup" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "currency": "USD",
    "trigger": "threshold",
    "method": "fixed",
    "amount_minor": 2900,
    "monthly_cap_minor": 2900
  }'
```
